Job Description
Posted Thursday, July 30, 2026 at 7:00 AM

HOK is a collective of future-forward thinkers and designers who are driven to face the critical challenges of our time. We are dedicated to improving people's lives, serving our clients and healing the planet. Together, we cultivate a culture of design excellence at the confluence of art and science, blending the power of creative expression with a clear sense of purpose.

In partnership with the Project Architect and Project Designer, accountable for project financial performance and team communication. Manages one or more projects during all phases of a project until completion. Directs employees and consultants at all levels to ensure that proper steps and procedures are taken and that work is completed as planned, budgeted, scheduled and in conformance with the design intent.

Leadership

Fosters and maintains a collaborative professional working relationship with the Project Leadership Team.
Participates on and/or leads multiple project teams as Project Manager.
Assists senior management in developing and validating project scope and fee, budget, and scope of services during the marketing and contract development process.
Assists in preparing project presentations. May participate and/or lead client presentations.
Consistently provides complete and timely communication of project information to and from clients and project team. Responsible for managing project using the Deltek Project Management system; completes work plans in Deltek; including identification of project team members, budget, consultants, schedule for completion, fees and costs as well as project change notices or other actions taking place on the assigned project.
Assists senior management in the preparation and execution of consultant contracts.
Assists with negotiating fees and contracts.
Ensures that budgets have been developed to provide for Quality Management Program through the life of the Project.
Incorporates Integrated Sustainable Design solutions into projects.
Takes personal responsibility for fostering a green workplace through sustainable work practices.
Fosters a commitment to external and internal client service.

Management

Works with Project Architect to avoid or eliminate conflicts in schedule due to the changes in various projects.
Plans, organizes and manages project. Provides on-going communication through team meetings/minutes/up-date memos to project team.
Communicates with consultants, contractors, sub-consultants and other disciplines to ensure effective communication.
Monitors construction administration during the construction phase
Develops and maintains positive relationships with clients and consultants.

Client Interface

Responsible for maintaining client relationships throughout project. Keeps client apprised of project progress on regular basis. Initiates and maintains contact with other key project individuals for clarification, coordination and negotiation of critical issues.
Consults with client to determine function and spatial requirements and prepares information regarding design, specifications, materials, color, equipment, estimated costs, and construction time. Plans layouts of projects and integrates engineering elements into unified design for client review and approval.

Business Development

Participates in developing annual business plan for the business unit.
Identifies new business opportunities while developing current client relationships. Listens for and seek out new projects which may exist or are being formulated.
Participates in selected marketing and business development opportunities.
Assists in development of fee proposals for marketing proposals.

Staff Development

Provides leadership including professional development coaching and mentoring staff.
Defines staff requirements for projects as needed or directed. Makes recommendations to senior management for staff promotions/terminations for project team and Architecture discipline. May participate in interviews and recruiting of professional staff.

Bachelor’s degree in architecture or equivalent in education or experience required. Master’s degree preferred.
5 years’ experience in architectural practice with management experience in all phases of projects through post-occupancy.
Licensed Architect with current registration in your region preferred, if licensure is offered in your region.

Travel may be required.
Overtime may be required.
The job duties and requirements that this document describes may be altered or supplemented at any time at the sole discretion of HOK.

Many of our roles require the use of specific software. Please refer to the Required and Preferred Software & Skills for details.

HOK invests in its people and communities, supporting both personal and professional growth through every stage of life. At HOK you’ll have a hybrid work environment, 10 paid holidays (including 2 floating holidays) and a minimum of 4 weeks of paid time off with a cash out option.

HOK offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, free mental wellness resources, life and AD&D coverage and short and long-term disability benefits. HOK supports your growing family by offering 4 weeks of paid parental leave and fertility coverage.

HOK helps to fund your future financial needs with matching contributions to our 401(K) plan which includes a well-rounded investment menu as well as free guidance on retirement planning.

Wherever you are in your career, HOK provides opportunities to learn, develop and utilize your skills. Continued learning is promoted through financial support and study prep for licensure exams, CEU credit opportunities, mentorship programs, and paid professional memberships. To learn more about designing your career with HOK, explore our current job openings.

HOK is an EOE, including disability/vets.

Compensation is based on experience, qualifications, education and location. The reasonably expected salary range for this position is $120,000 to $150,000. Other compensation may include a discretionary bonus.

We thrive on multi-disciplinary engagement, practicing at the intersection of architecture, interiors, and urban design. As a Project Manager, you will…

Set direction, in collaboration with each project’s Partner/Principal-in-Charge, Design Partner, Senior Designer, and Project Architect, for the execution of project goals and objectives with project team and client, define of scope, identify items for investigation, and develop novel concepts and methods.
Independently develop project proposals and contracts, define and manage work plans, organize and supervise design teams, participate in presentations and interviews and find creative solutions to project challenges.
Serve as the primary client liaison.
Cultivate and maintain long-term relationships with clients while managing projects both large and small.
Proactively manage teams from concept design through construction and have a deep understanding of building, zoning, energy codes, ADA, construction standards, and other regulatory requirements.
Optimize every team member’s opportunity for growth and professional development.
Display a passion for design excellence and exceptional project delivery while pursuing the highest value possible for our clients.

Seek engagement and collaboration at all levels, including the internal and external design team, clients and contractors.

Fluidly move between project management tasks, production, and marketing as needed, dependent on office priorities.

Comfortable and effective in a leadership capacity to bring exceptional creativity and excellent technical knowledge to the delivery of high quality and complex healthcare projects.
Excellent communication skills enabling you to establish and maintain project criteria, communicate them to project teams, and manage projects with confidence and ease while ensuring design intention is maintained throughout all project phases.

Role: Senior Program Manager, Client Experience

Location: New York City (hybrid)

Type: Full-Time

Apply here

At Athletics, Client Experience is intentionally designed to build trust and drive outcomes for both our clients and the agency. We believe great creative work thrives when clarity, momentum, and thoughtful structure are considered.

We’re seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead complex branding and strategic initiatives for forward-thinking organizations. This role sits at the intersection of strategic account partnership and program delivery. You are responsible for translating brand and digital engagements into structured, scalable programs while shaping client relationships that deepen over time. You protect creative excellence by building the systems, alignment, and foresight that allow it to thrive.

This role is posted at the Senior Program Manager level. Depending on experience and demonstrated scope of ownership, we may consider candidates at the Program Manager level, with corresponding adjustments to title and compensation.

You will serve as the architect of the engagement. You bring order to ambiguity, stay calm in complexity, align stakeholders around clear outcomes, and anticipate friction before it slows momentum. You operate as both a strategic thought partner to clients and a delivery leader internally, ensuring programs are creatively ambitious, commercially sound, and operationally rigorous.

Senior Program Managers are not task managers. They are stewards of long-term partnerships, accountable for client success, project clarity, profitability, and identifying areas for program growth.

Program Leadership
Lead large, multi-disciplinary branding and digital projects. Define program architecture: scope, phasing, success metrics, and stakeholder alignment.
Elevate conversations beyond deliverables, helping clients clarify priorities, navigate tradeoffs, and make confident decisions.
Client Engagement & Partnership Development
Serve as a primary point of contact and trusted advisor. Design a Client Experience that is proactive, transparent, and insight-driven (not reactive or transactional).
Identify and shape natural growth opportunities grounded in client need and program evolution.
Delivery Excellence & Risk Management
Own end-to-end execution across scope, timeline, budget, and quality. Proactively identify risks, surface tensions early, and propose solutions before issues escalate.
Ensure work is delivered to brief, aligned to strategic intent, and executed with operational discipline.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment
Partner closely with Strategy, Creative, Technology, and the Resourcing Director to assemble and support the right teams. Create clarity in roles, expectations, and decision-making authority.
Financial Accountability
Track and report on financial health across engagements. Forecast resource needs, manage profitability, and identify efficiencies across your programs.
Process Improvement
Help advance internal tools and systems to improve clarity, collaboration, and delivery. Bring a continuous improvement mindset to the team.
Mentorship & Leadership
Provide thoughtful guidance and leadership to junior team members, supporting growth while upholding standards of excellence. Model calm, decisive leadership in high-pressure moments.

Clients seek your perspective early, not just your updates.
Programs consistently meet or exceed project health expectations.
Teams describe your program plans as clear, decisive, and enabling.
You proactively identify risks (and potential solutions) before they become client-facing challenges.
Engagements evolve into long-term partnerships (when feasible).

5+ years of experience managing branding programs in a creative agency or consultancy environment.
Proven success leading complex, high-stakes projects from pitch through launch.
Fluency in brand strategy, visual identity, and digital product design/development processes.
Strong business acumen: able to forecast, scope, budget, and communicate with clarity and confidence.
Empathy and diplomacy: able to manage client relationships and internal dynamics with nuance. You’re calm under pressure and bring a positive mindset
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can lead a room or finesse a slide deck with ease.
Experience working and experimenting with both traditional project management best practice tools like Notion, Smartsheet, and similar, alongside rapidly evolving AI platforms
Bachelor’s degree required; project management certifications and/or advanced degrees are a plus.

Athletics is a brand innovation studio based in NYC, working with organizations at the forefront of culture, technology, and design. We are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where creativity thrives and careers grow.

This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of creative delivery at a growing studio—balancing structure with ambition, and process with possibility.

Athletics operates in a hybrid model, with employees working in-person from our studio in Brooklyn, NY a minimum of 2 days per week. Our model has flexibility for our team built-in, including fully remote options during the summer, plus remote work week allowances in the fall, winter, and spring. Candidates should be based in proximity to NYC and able to work in-person in accordance with our policy.

Base salary $90-120K, depending on experience and skillset. Benefits for full-time employees include participation in a value-sharing plan with bonus payouts; health insurance; 401k with guaranteed employee contribution; life insurance; generous paid time off; professional development budget; weekly team meals and in-office snacks; free Citibike memberships; + additional health and wellness perks.

Would you like to lead ambitious projects, take on responsibility, and work with a team to develop compelling solutions? Do you have experience in project management, the ability to keep track of the big picture, and a keen eye for quality? If so, we look forward to getting to know you.

C.F. Møller Architects is one of Scandinavia’s leading architectural firms and has been synonymous with award-winning architecture in the Nordic countries and around the world for over 100 years. Our work combines experience, innovation, and Nordic values to create architectural quality that meets both sustainable and aesthetic standards. In this way, we create solutions with lasting value—for clients, users, and society.

C.F. Møller Architects has also had a presence in Berlin for the past seven years. In our office, located on a bright top floor in Schöneberg between Gleisdreieckpark and the Neue Nationalgalerie, an international team of over 35 architects works on a wide variety of projects.

For our Berlin office, we are currently seeking experienced architects to lead challenging projects in Germany, particularly in the areas of office, administrative, cultural, research, and education buildings. You will become part of the multidisciplinary team at C.F. Møller Architects, where a passion for design, holistic thinking, and the commitment to turning creative ideas into compelling solutions shape our daily work.

You are an architect with extensive experience in project management and are familiar with the diverse requirements of complex construction projects—from conception through planning to completion. You are skilled at confidently integrating design, technical, economic, and organizational aspects.

You possess a strong architectural and technical understanding that enables you to confidently assess the quality of plans and develop compelling solutions to both design and structural challenges. Managing budgets, deadlines, and processes is just as much a part of your role as maintaining close coordination with senior management.

Your leadership skills are based on experience leading teams and projects, as well as on an empathetic, engaging, and clear communication style. When interacting with colleagues, clients, and specialist planners, you come across as confident, professional, and solution-oriented.

You bring five to seven years’ experience in project management in German-speaking countries, as well as in-depth knowledge of all project phases.

You combine a commitment to quality down to the last detail with a clear view of the bigger picture, and you stand out for your dedication, attention to detail, openness, team spirit and forward-thinking approach. Excellent communication skills and a good command of German and English are essential.

Proficiency in Revit/BIM, MS Office and Adobe CS rounds off your profile.

We offer you a permanent, full-time position with a salary commensurate with your experience and performance, as well as the opportunity to work independently and take on responsibility. As part of an international team of around 300 colleagues across eight locations, you will be introduced to the in-house standards of C.F. Møller Architects.

Your place of work is Berlin. In addition, you will occasionally travel to the sites of our construction projects and to our headquarters in Denmark.

We support your professional and personal development through internal seminars and regular participation in external training programs. You can expect a dedicated team characterized by open communication, mutual respect, and strong camaraderie.

Practical Information
Please submit your complete application materials in German or English via our career portal.

Your application should include a compelling portfolio, a cover letter, and a resume in table format specifying your available start date and salary expectations, as a PDF file no longer than 50 pages or 20 MB.

Description

The Senior Project Manager / Campus Planner is a firmwide planning leader responsible for managing complex campus and institutional planning projects while also providing hands-on planning expertise in Space Planning/Programming and Urban/Campus Design.

Project Leadership & Delivery
Lead planning efforts from programming and concept through documentation and client presentations, driving high-quality outcomes with minimal direction.

Internal Coordination

Coordinate internal resources and planning support, helping teams stay aligned on priorities and deadlines.
Partner with design leadership to drive great planning outcomes and cohesive presentations.
Team Leadership & Mentorship
Provide motivation, mentorship, and design leadership to planning staff through all phases of work.
Mentor planning and architectural staff, helping build technical proficiency and leadership skills.
Support team development through coaching, feedback, and modeling best practices for planning process and communication.

Operate with a service-focused approach while maintaining accountability to client requirements, expectations, and budget.
Support scope clarity and change management to protect schedule and profitability.

Attend interviews and contribute to interview strategy and presentation quality.
Engage in both internal and external business development efforts, supporting relationship building and opportunity cultivation.

Urban/Campus Design: Lead large-scale campus and district planning, policy frameworks, infrastructure strategy, and cross-disciplinary coordination.
Site Analysis: Conduct complex site evaluations, including sustainability considerations, infrastructure planning, and multidisciplinary integration.
Data Analysis: Apply advanced data modeling, scenario planning, and predictive analytics to inform planning direction and decision-making.
AHJ / Regulatory: Lead zoning analysis and support code/CEQA compliance; understand approval processes and ensure alignment with local/state/federal regulations.

Demonstrates design leadership, motivating teams and delivering strong planning outcomes with only intermittent oversight.

Produces high-quality planning graphics and narratives with strong visual storytelling and production skills.
Communicates clearly and persuasively in writing and verbally, including facilitation and client-facing presentations.
Has a track record of leading client meetings, managing expectations, and building trusted relationships.
Successfully coordinates multidisciplinary consultant teams and integrates inputs into cohesive deliverables.

At KPFF Consulting Engineers, we are more than just an engineering design firm. For 65 years, we have dedicated ourselves to innovative, sustainable engineering that shapes the built environment and tackles complex infrastructure challenges. Job Description

We’re hiring a Structural Project Manager to support and grow our Austin, Texas team. This senior-level role is ideal for a licensed structural engineer ready to lead complex building design projects, deepen client relationships, and contribute to the continued expansion of KPFF’s presence across Central Texas and surrounding markets.

At KPFF, you’ll manage vertical structure projects from concept through construction administration, mentor a talented group of engineers, and actively support business development initiatives. You’ll collaborate closely with architects, developers, owners, and contractors to deliver high-quality structural designs for commercial, residential, mixed-use, education, healthcare, and institutional projects.

As you grow with us, you’ll also have opportunities to pursue pathways to ownership, reflecting KPFF’s commitment to recognizing leadership, technical excellence, and long-term contributions.

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of being in the Austin office three days per week for collaboration, mentoring, and client meetings. While we support flexible work arrangements, this role is not fully remote. In-person presence is especially important for leadership engagement, technical mentorship, and client interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing

Serve as the primary technical and client-facing lead on structural projects, ensuring strong relationships and successful delivery.
Lead project execution from schematic design through construction administration, managing schedules, budgets, quality standards, and team performance.
Oversee and review structural analysis and design for steel, concrete, wood, and masonry building systems.
Direct preparation of construction documents including calculations, drawings, specifications, and design narratives.
Coordinate closely with architects, MEP consultants, contractors, fabricators, and specialty structural reviewers.
Collaborate with teams in both Austin and San Diego, supporting projects across markets as part of our integrated reporting center structure.
Navigate Texas jurisdictional approval processes and building code compliance, including:
International Building Code (IBC) and local amendments
City of Austin Development Services Department
Special inspections and threshold building coordination
Provide construction-phase support including shop drawing review, RFIs, site observations, and field coordination.
Support business development efforts including proposals, interviews, and cultivating relationships with local clients and design partners.
Mentor and develop engineers and designers, fostering both technical excellence and leadership growth.
Represent KPFF in industry organizations and local professional groups, contributing to the visibility and reputation of the Austin team.

Bachelor’s degree in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering with structural emphasis (Master’s preferred).
PE license required.
8+ years of structural engineering experience, primarily focused on building design.
Proven experience managing multi-discipline building projects and coordinating consultant teams.
Strong working knowledge of steel, concrete, wood, and masonry design.
Experience applying national codes and standards including IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, ACI, NDS, and TMS specifications.
Proficiency with structural analysis and design tools such as ETABS, RAM, RISA, SAFE, and project coordination platforms, with working familiarity drafting tools used by production teams.
Demonstrated leadership capabilities with experience mentoring staff engineers.
Effective communicator with strong organizational and client-facing skills.
Ability to work in the Austin office at least three days per week under the hybrid work model.
Additional Information

Physical Demands

Work is primarily performed in a standard office setting with long periods of work at a computer.
Occasional lifting of items up to 15 pounds.
Visits to construction sites may involve walking, standing, climbing stairs or ladders, navigating uneven surfaces, or exposure to weather.
Local travel may be required for project meetings, observations, or client visits.

The expected salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000 with candidates who have at least 8 years of experience, proven project management skills, and business development success. Final compensation will also consider education, licensure, and overall skills. We also provide performance-based bonuses to recognize outstanding contributions.

For those who demonstrate long-term impact and leadership, KPFF offers pathways to ownership, creating opportunities to directly share in the firm’s growth and success. During the interview process, we’ll review the full compensation package and answer any questions you may have.

At KPFF, your career growth and well-being matter. We offer a supportive environment that values autonomy, innovation, and teamwork. Here, your contributions are celebrated, your ideas are welcomed, and your career has room to grow.

Mentorship & Growth: Through KPFF’s Forefront Education Program, you’ll have access to continuous learning, leadership development, and opportunities to advance your career while helping others do the same.
Strong Connections: We believe in trust, collaboration, and long-term relationships, both with our clients and within our teams. Open communication and teamwork are at the heart of how we operate.
Supportive Culture: Your well-being matters. We encourage balance, provide resources for a healthy lifestyle, and create opportunities to connect through social activities and community events.

We’re proud to offer flexible and competitive benefits, including:

Perform marketing, business development, and consulting activities with existing and new clients.
Act as proposal manager and assist in the proposal preparation, review of contract terms and conditions, and evaluate risks associated with the services being offered. Develop the scope of work for the project.
Implement quality control checks per established procedures (e.g., organize and lead routine design reviews and internal quality assurance reviews).
Conduct negotiations to obtain the client’s approval and perform the contract administration of the change order.
Provide training and mentoring to project team staff on project management and project consulting issues.
Routinely report project progress to the Business Group Manager and Operations leaders.

10 years of relevant utility scale power project management experience
Demonstrated business development and strategic planning skills.
Good communication, leadership, planning and mentoring skills.
Excellent organizational, project management and communication (both written and verbal) skills.
MS Office, Adobe and other relevant software experience
TX PE or ability to obtain reciprocity

Bachelor's degree in Engineering
7 years related experience inclusive of a minimum 2 years experience in project management

Demonstrated leadership skills

Senior Project Manager (Healthcare Architecture)
· (195659)

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe architecture is more than designing buildings, it’s about providing solutions to societal challenges and creating stronger, more vibrant communities. As part of our Architecture practice at HDR, you’ll contribute to the design and delivery of spaces and experiences that advance community well-being around the world.

From healing environments and learning spaces to research labs and civic landmarks and infrastructure, your work will directly influence how individuals experience the world around them. We bring together architects, planners, designers, and technical experts to solve complex design challenges with creativity, curiosity, and collaboration.

From championing design excellence with an emphasis on resilience and sustainability to pioneering innovative building technologies, your contributions will leave a lasting impact on the built environment. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to drive meaningful change and help define the future of our communities.

s.h: In the role of Senior Project Manager, we'll count on you to
s.t:
Lead complex healthcare projects from planning through design, construction, and closeout

Independently coordinate work of Project Architects and balance multidiscipline teams throughout the entire project's development

Be involved with marketing, contractual, design and production meetings

Facilitate design work sessions during all phases of delivery with the client and their representatives; and facilitate sessions in collaboration with the Project Architect and other disciplines as required to advance the work throughout all phases of delivery

Experience with California healthcare projects, including OSHPD-1 and OSHPD-3, navigating reviews, approvals, code compliance, and coordination with AHJ

Lead user group meetings and stakeholder engagement sessions with clinicians, administrators, and facilities teams to guide decision making

Coordinate staffing workload through entire project development to complete documents on schedule

Coordinate with contractors and trade partners to develop and manage pull planning schedules using Last Planner System principles, improving workflow reliability, team alignment, and schedule performance

Track financial aspects of projects, including forecasting and coordinate and adjust work effort with team to ensure that work is completed within parameters of agreed-to schedule and internal labor budget

Work with the Health Principal, Regional Controller and Managing Principal for project reviews with corporate management as needed

Champion quality control and assurance process by working with Quality Management Coordinator to facilitate quality meetings throughout all phases of project development

Participate in marketing activities representing project management requirements of proposals, schedules, fees, interview teams, etc.

Strengthen client relations through excellence in project delivery

Experience and/or interest in sustainable design/LEED PMP certification

Experience with California healthcare projects, including OSHPD-1 and OSHPD-3

Bachelor's degree in Architecture
10 years related experience
A minimum 5 years project management experience
Registered Architect
Must be able to lead a team on projects
Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Project)
Knowledge and experience within the local and regional market
Good planning and mentoring skills
An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must

What We Believe
HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.

Our Commitment
As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.

Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

We provide a comprehensive benefits package that promotes employee ownership, employee health, performance, and success, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, an employee assistance program, paid time away, parental leave, paid holidays, a retirement savings plan with employer match, employee referral bonus and tuition reimbursement.

Stated benefits are for full-time regular positions. The expected compensation range for this position is San Francisco $156,156.00 - $223,080.00 and Folsom, CA $132,132 - $188,750 annually depending upon skills, experience, education and geographical location.

The incumbent responsibilities must align with the National FAASTeam Annual Performance Plan (NPP) to accomplish the National Program Guidance (NPG) with respect to aviation education. Aviation safety education is an integral part of meeting the FAA¿s statutory obligation to promote aviation safety.

The FAA provides aviation education and guidance to all segments of the aviation community. Aviation education targets the General Aviation (GA) community and serves an important human factors role in the FAA relationship with the flying public.

Technical Administration Manages policies, standards, programs, and procedures for aviation and commercial operations. Establishes collaborative relationships with external aviation organizations to address safety issues and seeks innovative mitigation strategies of such issues.

Analyzes safety issues and seeks a wide range of regulatory and non-regulatory responses to ensure rapid adoption of remedies to aviation safety concerns.

Responsible and accountable for representing the FAA in coordinating system safety programs such as safety assurance, safety promotion, and risk management activities within the aviation environment.

Interfaces include certificated airmen, air carriers, air agencies, air operators, general aviation organizations, designees, the general public and airport organizations. Participates with industry, internal and external work groups, and teams to address specific safety concerns and aviation issues.

Develops guidance and associated products to implement policies addressing safety and related aviation requirements. Program Management Manages aviation safety procedures, local initiatives, and supports national products.

Determines appropriate goals and objectives for the airworthiness portion of the aviation safety program in coordination with national FAASTeam guidance. Implements and manages comprehensive safety action plans and programs by utilizing FAASTeam Representative Volunteers.

Provides technical assistance to other national and international aviation safety organizations and maintains close liaison with those external national and international aviation organizations, certificated airmen, air carriers, air agencies, air operators, general aviation organizations, designees and airport organizations, to identify and resolve potential safety problems and establish safety programs.

Supports the national FAASTeam Policy Division(s) in FAA-wide and community aviation education programs. Responsible for the promotion and education of regulatory compliance in safety related areas. Analyzes investigative data, develops recommendations, and keeps management informed of the status of identified hazards and the safety program.

Supports management in decisions regarding the safety program. Participates and/or serves as an advisor in joint FAA-industry meetings, steering committees, and other workgroups. Resource Management Plans assigned program to meet goals and develops budget estimates for quarterly and annual projections.

Manages, recruits, trains, and supports a diverse team of volunteer FAASTeam Representatives to meet identified goals and objectives.

Flight Program Participates in the FAA flight program to maintain qualification and currency requirements applicable to operations inspectors, for the purpose of supporting the FAA in a variety of flight-related functions to include training and evaluation of designated pilot examiners.

Evaluates tasks contained in the FAA practical test standards and airman certification standards by participating as pilot in command or as a crewmember. The inspector is required to maintain an FAA second class medical. Other Maintains technical proficiency within the assigned specialty.

In support of Flight Standards District Office operations, performs other duties as assigned except for enforcement actions. Performs other duties as assigned.
Aviation Safety Series, 1825 General Requirements for All Positions: Not more than two separate incidents involving Federal aviation regulations violations in the last 5 years; Valid State driver's license; Fluency in the English language; No chemical dependencies or drug abuse that could interfere with job performance; and High school diploma or equivalent.

Medical Requirements for All Positions: Applicants must be physically able to perform the duties of the Aviation Safety Inspector position in a safe and efficient manner, with or without a reasonable accommodation.

The minimum medical requirements include the following requirements: Have good distant vision in each eye and be able to read, without strain, printed materials the size of typewritten characters (glasses and contact lenses permitted); Have the ability to hear the conversational voice (hearing aid permitted); and Not have any physical condition that would cause them to be a hazard to themselves or others that would interfere with their ability to fly as passengers in a variety of aircraft.

In addition, applicants for positions that require participation in the operation of the aircraft must: Possess a valid second ¿ class medical certificate in accordance with FAA regulations; and Pass recurrent medical examinations as prescribed by the FAA.

Applicants tentatively selected will be required to: Provide documentation from a board-certified physician certifying that they meet the minimal medical requirements, with or without a reasonable accommodation; or Individuals who do not meet the minimum medical requirements but who are otherwise qualified will receive an individualized assessment to determine whether they can perform the essential functions of the position with or without a reasonable accommodation.

To qualify for this position you must meet the Office of Personnel Management Qualification Standards for the 1825 series, you must demonstrate in your application that you possess at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to GS/FG-13 as an Aviation Safety Inspector (GAO).

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position. Specialized experience is: experience assisting, conducting, or performing various technical functions related to certification, surveillance, investigation, and enforcement activities.

In addition, when the predominant work involves General Aviation Operations, applicants for Aviation Safety Inspector (Operations) positions must meet all of the following requirements: Valid, unexpired Flight Instructor Certificate with single and multi-engine airplane and instrument airplane ratings.

Must have given a minimum of 200 hours of flight instruction in an aircraft. Professional flying skill as demonstrated in a flight check to Commercial Pilot Certificate with an instrument rating; Possession of Airline Transport Pilot Certificate or Commercial Pilot Certificate with instrument airplane rating.

Minimum of 100 flight hours within the last 3 years. Minimum of 1,500 total flight hours. Possession of single and multi-engine land airplane ratings. Not more than 2 flying accidents in the last 5 years in which the applicant's pilot error was involved. Possession of a valid second-class FAA medical certificate.

The recency of specialized experience is waived for current FAA employees in the 1825 series. Applicants should include examples of specialized experience in their Work History. Qualifications must be met by the closing date of this vacancy announcement.

**Contexte**
Dans le cadre du renforcement de sa feuille de route Cybersécurité, notre client, un groupe international basé en Suisse, recherche un **Chef de Projet GRC Senior** pour rejoindre son organisation IT / Cybersécurité.
Le consultant interviendra au sein d-une équipe **Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)** et aura pour mission de cadrer, piloter et coordonner plusieurs projets transverses liés à la gouvernance, aux risques, à la conformité et à la cybersécurité.
Le rôle nécessite une forte capacité de structuration, de coordination et de communication avec des interlocuteurs IT, métiers et fonctions support.
**Responsabilités**
Cadrage et planification du portefeuille projets
* Prendre en main le contexte, les travaux existants, les parties prenantes et les dépendances.
* Formaliser les **Project Charters** : objectifs, périmètre, gouvernance, responsabilités, livrables, jalons et critères de succès.
* Construire et maintenir une roadmap consolidée du portefeuille.
* Identifier les priorités, capacités, dépendances et chemins critiques.
* Mettre en place les outils de pilotage et assurer leur maintien à jour.
Pilotage opérationnel des projets GRC
* Élaborer et suivre les plans projets, jalons, charges, actions, risques, problèmes et décisions.
* Coordonner les équipes internes, externes et les différentes parties prenantes.
* Organiser et animer les comités projets, ateliers et réunions de coordination.
* Identifier les dérives et assurer les alertes auprès des parties prenantes concernées.
* Préparer les décisions, arbitrages et plans d'actions.
* Assurer le suivi du cycle de vie des livrables : production, revue, validation, versioning et archivage.
Reporting et suivi des activités RUN
* Produire une vision consolidée de l-avancement du portefeuille.
* Assurer le reporting auprès du management et des instances de gouvernance.
* Suivre notamment les indicateurs d-avancement, planning, capacité, risques, dépendances, actions et décisions.
* Consolider les indicateurs liés aux activités récurrentes de l-équipe GRC.
* Identifier les écarts et suivre les actions correctives jusqu-à leur clôture.
Qualité, audit et conformité
* Mettre en cohérence les objectifs des projets, contrôles attendus, preuves et plans de remédiation.

* Assurer le suivi des actions issues des audits et constats jusqu-à leur clôture.
* Veiller à la qualité et à la traçabilité de la documentation projet.
Conduite du changement et passage en RUN
* Coordonner les besoins de communication et d-adoption avec les équipes concernées.
* Préparer et organiser le passage des projets en RUN.
* Réaliser les clôtures de projets et documenter les résultats, risques résiduels et actions restantes.

Most of what you manage is hardware, but every hardware decision touches software and data science, and you make sure those pieces move together.
Development happens in-house, but parts of it are outsourced to production partners and component suppliers. Our Sales Engineering team owns the customer relationship; you make sure their requirements turn into delivered systems.
You take ownership end to end, hold yourself to a high standard, and focus on outcomes that matter for the customer. You communicate openly, give honest feedback, and build trust through your actions.

Ability to perform the full range of supervisory duties. Ability to develop and effectively deliver presentations and/or training. Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing.

Team & Role
Moveworks, now part of ServiceNow, is building the agentic AI layer that sits between every employee and the systems they rely on. Following the acquisition, the Moveworks Business Unit is one of the most strategically important investments at ServiceNow — and the scope of what we own is expanding fast.

We are looking for a Director-level Technical Program Manager (Individual Contributor) to lead our most critical programs end to end, starting with the ServiceNow integration and growing into a broader portfolio over time as the BU scales.
This is a senior, highly technical IC role for someone who has spent most of their career running infrastructure, platform modernization, or large-scale distributed systems programs. You will manage the program — directly, end to end — and your influence will come from technical depth, sharp judgment, and an ability to align engineering leaders, executives, and partner organizations around a single execution plan. As the Moveworks BU scope expands, so will yours.

s.h: What you get to do in this role
s.t:
Own the Moveworks Infrastructure portfolio of strategic and technical initiatives. Your primary focus will be to drive the roadmap and execution plans for Moveworks Infrastructure initiatives; as you scale you will also take over from engineering infra operational processes like capacity planning and budgeting
Focus on initiatives expanding MW Infra footprint . We are moving to a tri-cloud + on-prem + SPC strategy where we need to develop the tools and process for managing our infra stack across diverse environments. Align any ambiguous strategic direction into concrete milestones, dependencies, and decision points.
Run the program, not the people . As the TPM, you will be the connective tissue across engineering, product, design, security, GTM, finance, and field organizations — driving outcomes through clarity, structured decision-making, and relentless follow-through.
Identify and resolve technical misalignment . Spot misalignment across teams, architectures, and roadmaps early — before it becomes a delivery risk — and partner with engineering leads to drive resolution quickly. Lead architecture reviews, surface cross-system risks (latency budgets, blast radius, multi-tenancy, AI safety, evals), and broker tradeoffs between engineering teams.
Build the operating system for the program . Status, risk, scope, and decision logs that engineering directors and VPs actually read. Quarterly planning rhythms that reflect reality. Executive narratives that are honest about where things stand.
Be the senior partner to engineering leadership . Pair directly with Distinguished Engineers, VPs of Engineering, and product leaders. Represent the program to the CTO, CPO, and executive staff. Own the message.
Define TPM excellence . As we grow and expand our TPM team, you will serve as the model for how to operate. Set the standard for what senior technical program management looks like at Moveworks, mentor TPMs across the org without being their manager, and codify the patterns that scale.

12+ years of technical program management experience, with most of that time spent on infrastructure, platform, cloud, reliability, developer productivity, or modernization programs. You have operated at staff, principal, or director IC scope on programs where the hard part was not coordination alone, but understanding technical dependencies, sequencing migrations, managing reliability risk, and helping engineering leaders make durable tradeoffs.
Deep technical fluency across infrastructure modernization domains — distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes, multi-region and multi-cloud architectures, hyperscaler platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity, data platforms, observability, reliability, and migration strategy. You do not need to be the architect, but you need enough technical depth to pressure-test plans, spot cross-system risk, and earn credibility with senior engineers.
A track record of leading cross-org programs involving 100+ engineers, multiple VPs, and competing roadmaps — ideally including at least one large-scale integration, migration, or platform unification.
Excellent written communication. You can compress a 200-engineer program into a one-page exec narrative without losing the truth of it. You write decision docs that hold up under scrutiny.
Strong technical judgment under ambiguity. You know when to dig in, when to delegate to engineering leads, and when to escalate. You are comfortable saying “this plan won’t work” in a room full of senior leaders.

Prior IC senior TPM experience at a hyperscaler, large SaaS platform, or AI-first company.
Comfort operating across SaaS, on-prem regulated, and government cloud (FedRAMP, IL5) deployment models.
Experience leading post-acquisition technical integration programs at scale.
Background in agentic AI, conversational AI, or AI assistant platforms — you understand why agent runtimes, tool calling, RAG, and evals are not the same problem.

s.h: What Success Looks Like in the First Year
s.t:
Quarter 1: You have a grasp of the Moveworks replatform roadmap and are driving the execution plan for the first release helping the team address blockers. Engineering leaders across ServiceNow and Moveworks trust your judgment and pull you into the rooms that matter.
Quarter 2: You are able to scale to drive multiple releases going on in parallel on the Moveworks replatforming roadmap as well as the current infrastructure expansion and improvement initiatives, and proactively surface key risks to the plans and drive the path to mitigation. The executive staff has confidence in the plan because the plan is honest.
Quarter 3-4: Team has successfully delivered 1 or 2 releases on the roadmap under your leadership; major milestones land on time and at quality, and you are a trusted partner for infrastructure leadership and team

This role is especially compelling for senior TPMs who have operated in high-scale infrastructure environments and want more ownership than a narrowly-scoped platform program can offer. You will get the scale, technical complexity, and executive visibility of a large technology company, combined with the pace, ambiguity, and scope expansion of a fast-growing AI business unit.
Most senior TPM roles come with a fixed scope and focus on driving meetings and reporting the status. This one is different. It is a seat at the center of the Moveworks BU which is growing at an unprecented rate — your scope will expand as the BU scales. You will be measured by the technical and business outcomes you drive. If you thrive in an environment where you have the agency to move the needle for the company and learn something new every single day, then this role is for you.

Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

We're looking for a Solutions and Implementation Manager to join our Customer Experience team, managing the delivery and implementation of Micad FM , our estates management platform, for our UK customer base. We're bolstering the team ahead of a high volume of upcoming implementations .
In this role, you'll be the technical expert who bridges the gap between sales and Customer Success – owning the customer journey from pre-sales through to complete implementation. If you're excited about managing complex technical projects, solving implementation challenges, and being the linchpin between our commercial and delivery teams, this is the opportunity for you!
Where will you be based? This role is remote within the UK, and the Cardiff area is our preference. If you're near Cardiff, we'd ask you to co-locate with the team around once a week; if you're based elsewhere in the UK, we bring the team together in person roughly once a quarter.
Our projects can be delivered remotely, but we travel to client sites where it's beneficial for the customer — expect an average of about one trip a month, so you'll need to be open to travel.
What you'll be doing
Lead customer onboarding and implementation – own the technical deployment of Micad FM for UK customers, configuring solutions to meet their specific requirements, delivering training, and ensuring successful go-live.
Act as a technical advisor and product expert – develop deep knowledge of Micad FM to guide customers through complex configurations, troubleshoot technical issues, demonstrate ROI, and identify opportunities to expand usage across their organisation.
Drive revenue growth and expansion – lead technical product discovery and demonstrations with Sales to scope additional modules, integrations, and services that deliver value.
Conduct strategic Success Planning – lead Success planning sessions with key accounts, demonstrating measurable outcomes and ensuring alignment between customer objectives and our solutions.
Work cross-functionally – partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product and Engineering to deliver a joined-up customer experience, provide product feedback, and advocate for customer needs internally.
Build the team and the playbook – work with our implementation lead to develop repeatable delivery processes, mentor colleagues, and help shape a high-performing implementation function as we scale.

Technical implementation experience – you have a proven track record in implementation, technical account management, or solutions consulting roles (ideally in SaaS, PropTech, CAFM, or B2B software), with the ability to configure and deploy software solutions.
Sales acumen and commercial awareness – you understand the customer lifecycle, can articulate ROI, and work collaboratively with sales teams to drive revenue growth.
Strong technical aptitude – you're comfortable learning complex software platforms, troubleshooting issues, and training end-users on best practices.
Excellent communicator and relationship builder – you can translate technical concepts into business value, build trust with stakeholders at all levels, and navigate complex organisational dynamics.
Data-driven and technically proficient – you're comfortable with CRM software (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), project management tools (e.g., Jira), and analysing customer data to drive decisions and demonstrate value.
What Success looks like in this role
You'll be measured on implementation completion rates, time to value , and the quality of technical engagement that moves deals to closed won.
Who you'll be working with and reporting to
You'll report to our Solutions and Implementation Team Lead and work closely with our Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams across SINGU. Our teams are highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences and growth.

Permanent contract with a competitive yearly salary , based on your experience.

Real ownership from day one — you'll lead technical implementations end to end, from sale through to successful go-live.
A pivotal moment to join — we're taking service delivery to the next level and looking for people ready to get stuck in and make a real impact.

Du hast bereits in einer Agentur gearbeitet , behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kundenprojekten den Überblick und fühlst dich zwischen Kundenmeeting, Contentproduktion und Projektplanung wohl?
Dann suchen wir dich als Projektmanager (m/w/d) für unser Team bei wirdenkenlokal .
Wir sind Medienhaus und Agentur mit Sitz in Nürnberg und unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbar zu werden , neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen . Dafür entwickeln und realisieren wir Projekte rund um Social Media, Video- und Fotoproduktion, Onlinekampagnen, PR und Events .
Für die Steuerung unserer Kundenprojekte suchen wir jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt , strukturiert arbeitet und gleichzeitig versteht, dass Agenturalltag nicht immer nach Lehrbuch läuft.
Aufgaben
Projektmanagement: Du übernimmst die eigenständige Steuerung unserer Agenturprojekte – von der Planung über die Koordination der Umsetzung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Dabei betreust du Social-Media-Projekte, Videoproduktionen, Fotoshootings und weitere Online-Marketing-Kampagnen.
Kundenbetreuung & Beratung: Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, führst regelmäßige Kundentermine und berätst sie entlang unseres Leistungsportfolios. Du verstehst, was der Kunde erreichen möchte, übersetzt Anforderungen in konkrete Aufgaben und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team passende Lösungen.
Koordination & Überblick: Mehrere Kunden, unterschiedliche Deadlines und verschiedene interne Ansprechpartner gleichzeitig? Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Du priorisierst Aufgaben, koordinierst Timings und Ressourcen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten wissen, was wann zu tun ist.
Contentproduktionen: Du bist nicht nur am Schreibtisch: Bei ausgewählten Video- und Fotoproduktionen unterstützt du unser Team vor Ort, koordinierst Abläufe und stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Kreativen sicher, dass die Anforderungen des Kunden umgesetzt werden.
Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Team: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Social-Media-Managern, Videografen, Fotografen und weiteren Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Informationen, Feedback und Freigaben laufen bei dir zusammen und werden von dir strukturiert weitergegeben.
Projektmanagement mit Awork: Wir organisieren unsere Projekte mit Awork. Du musst das Tool noch nicht kennen – Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie Awork, Asana, Monday, Trello oder vergleichbaren Lösungen setzen wir allerdings voraus.
KI & Prozessoptimierung: Wir nutzen KI bereits intensiv in unserem Arbeitsalltag und wollen das weiter ausbauen. Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sowohl innerhalb von Kundenprojekten als auch zur Optimierung unserer internen Prozesse einzusetzen, neue Möglichkeiten auszuprobieren und bestehende Abläufe kontinuierlich besser zu machen.
Qualifikation
Agenturerfahrung: Du hast bereits in einer Marketing-, Social-Media-, Digital-, Content- oder vergleichbaren Agentur gearbeitet und kennst die Dynamik des Agenturalltags.
Erfahrung im Online-Marketing: Du bringst praktische Vorerfahrung und ein gutes Verständnis für Social Media, Contentproduktion und Onlinekampagnen mit. Du musst nicht alles selbst umsetzen können – aber du solltest verstehen, wie gute Projekte in diesen Bereichen geplant und realisiert werden.
Organisationstalent: Du kannst mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig steuern, Prioritäten setzen und verlierst auch dann nicht den Überblick, wenn an einem Tag fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren.
Stressresistenz: Wenn es turbulent wird, wirst du nicht hektisch, sondern fokussiert. Du kannst mit Zeitdruck, kurzfristigen Änderungen und intensiveren Projektphasen umgehen und läufst dann eher zur Höchstform auf, als den Überblick zu verlieren.
Kommunikationsstärke: Eine klare, professionelle und zielführende Kommunikation – schriftlich wie mündlich – setzen wir voraus. Du kannst sowohl souverän mit Kunden kommunizieren als auch intern klare Briefings und Aufgaben formulieren.
Eigenverantwortung: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden nächsten Schritt vorgibt. Du erkennst, was zu tun ist, sprichst Probleme frühzeitig an und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte.
Interesse an Marketing & Medien: Social Media, Marketing, Medien und digitale Kommunikation interessieren dich auch über deine unmittelbaren Aufgaben hinaus. Du willst verstehen, welche Plattformen, Formate und Entwicklungen gerade relevant sind.
Offenheit für KI: ChatGPT, Claude und andere KI-Tools sind für dich keine Bedrohung, sondern Werkzeuge. Du hast Lust darauf, herauszufinden, wie wir damit bessere Ergebnisse erzielen und effizienter arbeiten können.

Abwechslung statt immer gleicher Projekte: Vom regionalen Mittelständler bis zum Konzern, von Social-Media-Betreuung über Recruitingkampagnen bis zur Videoproduktion: Du arbeitest mit Kunden aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen und an sehr unterschiedlichen Projekten.
Du siehst, was deine Arbeit bewirkt: Unsere Projekte sollen nicht einfach nur gut aussehen. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, sichtbarer zu werden, neue Kunden zu erreichen und passende Mitarbeitende zu gewinnen – insbesondere Unternehmen aus unserer Region.
Ein Arbeitsplatz mit Aussicht: Unser Büro befindet sich im Business Tower Nürnberg – in einem der höchsten Büros der Region.
Kurze Wege & flache Hierarchien: Du arbeitest in einem Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem nahbaren Führungsteam. Gute Ideen müssen bei uns nicht erst durch fünf Hierarchieebenen.
Moderne Arbeitsweise: Wir arbeiten digital, nutzen moderne Projektmanagement- und KI-Tools und entwickeln unsere internen Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.
Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns genauso dazu wie die notwendige Flexibilität, die ein abwechslungsreicher Agenturalltag manchmal mit sich bringt.
Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir wachsen als Unternehmen weiter – und damit entstehen auch für dich Möglichkeiten, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Sobre a posição
Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Technical Project Manager , responsável pela condução de projetos enterprise de Digital Commerce , combinando gestão de projetos, relacionamento com stakeholders e sólida capacidade técnica.
A posição terá papel central na conexão entre negócio, produto e tecnologia, garantindo clareza de escopo, planejamento, alinhamento entre equipes e qualidade das decisões técnicas ao longo do projeto.
Esperamos uma pessoa com experiência relevante em e-commerce B2C e B2B , conhecimento avançado da plataforma VTEX e capacidade para participar ativamente da definição de arquiteturas de solução e integrações. Perfil esperado
Procuramos uma pessoa que não atue apenas no acompanhamento operacional do projeto. O Technical Project Manager deve possuir profundidade técnica suficiente para compreender as soluções propostas, questionar decisões, identificar riscos e conduzir discussões de arquitetura , sem necessariamente assumir a responsabilidade pela implementação.
Também esperamos forte capacidade de relacionamento com clientes e stakeholders, organização para atuar em ambientes complexos e habilidade para transformar discussões técnicas e de negócio em planos de execução claros e objetivos.
Principais responsabilidades
Planejar e conduzir projetos enterprise de Digital Commerce , acompanhando escopo, cronograma, riscos, dependências e entregas.
Atuar como principal ponto de conexão entre stakeholders de negócio, times técnicos e demais áreas envolvidas no projeto.
Gerenciar escopo, prioridades e expectativas, conduzindo negociações com stakeholders quando houver mudanças, riscos ou conflitos de prioridade.
Conduzir cerimônias e processos de desenvolvimento utilizando Scrum e metodologias ágeis .
Estruturar planos de trabalho, acompanhar evolução das entregas e garantir visibilidade clara sobre status, riscos e próximos passos.
Traduzir necessidades de negócio em direcionamentos compreensíveis para os times técnicos.
Participar da definição e revisão de arquiteturas de solução , considerando requisitos funcionais, integrações, escalabilidade e restrições da plataforma.
Conduzir agendas técnicas relacionadas a arquiteturas de integração e fluxo de dados entre VTEX, ERPs, CRMs, OMS, sistemas de pagamento, logística, marketplaces e demais plataformas corporativas.
Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, desenvolvedores e especialistas para avaliar alternativas técnicas e apoiar decisões de solução.
Garantir alinhamento entre arquitetura, escopo acordado e objetivos de negócio.
Identificar antecipadamente riscos técnicos ou funcionais que possam impactar prazo, escopo ou qualidade da solução.
Organizar e conduzir workshops, refinamentos técnicos, sessões de discovery e alinhamentos de arquitetura.
Estruturar roteiros de demonstração , preparando cenários que evidenciem as principais capacidades e entregas do projeto.
Realizar demos, apresentações executivas e reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, lideranças e diretorias.
Comunicar temas técnicos de forma clara para públicos não técnicos, contextualizando impactos, riscos e decisões.

Note: Applicants with degrees in related fields, such as those listed above, who do not have the 12 semester hrs. of specified course work must have had at least 1 yr. of work experience in community planning acquired under the supervision & guidance of a community planner. -OR- B.

Combination of Education & Experience: Courses equivalent to a major in one of the above disciplines, or a combination of related courses totaling at least 24 semester hrs. in any combination of the above disciplines of which at least 12 semester hrs. were in the planning process, & socioeconomic & physical elements of planning, plus appropriate experience or additional education.

Basic Requirements for General Engineering Series 0801: A. Degree: Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree in engineering.

To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential & integral calculus and courses in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields & circuits; (f) nature & properties of materials; & (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics. -OR- B.

Combination of Education & Experience: College-level education, training, &/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, & (2) a good understanding, both theoretical & practical, of the engineering sciences & techniques & their applications to one of the branches of engineering.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following: 1. Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1, or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions. 2.

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico. 3.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, & engineering sciences & that included the courses specified in the basic requirements under paragraph A.

The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A. 4.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions. Basic Requirements for Landscape Architecture Series 0807: A.

Degree: Successful completion of a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree in landscape architecture or landscape design. -OR- B.

Combination of Education & Experience: For each year short of graduation, the applicant must have had 1 yr of experience under professional leadership & guidance of such character & diversity as to be a satisfactory substitute for the required education.

This experience must have included original landscape design. ** See Education Section for additional qualification requirements**

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Airbnb’s mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. As we grow to achieve that mission, we’re looking to add a technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Technical Program Manager (TPM) for the Payments team.
A person in this role will partner with our Payments organization to provide a cohesive set of technology offerings that enable everything related to moving money in Airbnb’s global marketplace - moving billions of dollars, in 191 countries, across 75 currencies, through a complex ecosystem of payments partners.

Within Payments Tech, we have Payments Platform, Compliance & Operations, Payments Engineering Services, and Payments Data Engineering. These programs work together to deliver reliable systems that allow guests and Hosts to make and receive payments with clarity and ease.

As our payments platform grows we’ll be adding new payment partners, global licenses, compliance and regulation controls, and building new payment experiences for our guests and hosts.
This role is deeply cross-organization, as projects will span across a wide surface area, and building positive relationships across a multitude of technical teams will be essential to the success of this leader.

We are looking for candidates who share our passion for tackling complexity head-on while supporting and growing a world class team of Technical Program Managers.

TPMs at Airbnb work on a variety of complex projects/ programs that touch multiple services, functions and teams, and hence are required to keep the big picture in focus while being
able to dive into the details, working through unique challenges we face daily. They're good at building relationships, motivating others with vision, and persuading with data. It is a highly leveraged role that aims to improve the quality and velocity of work across cross-functional teams by acting as a “force multiplier”.

This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks, discussing the technical trade-offs with engineers, and maintaining clear communications across multiple stakeholder groups across the organization. In short, they get things done by bringing clarity out of chaos, diving into the details, and communicating clearly and in a timely manner.
A Typical Day
Develop program scope and objectives, collaborate with all relevant stakeholders, ensure technical feasibility and drive projects end-to-end.
Align on staffing, priorities and technical dependencies within Hosting and cross-functional teams like Trust, Payments, Infra & Product both in terms of quarterly planning, and managing ongoing risk escalation/ mitigation.
Manage Technical Design diligence process for large programs, track technical dependencies, scheduling reviews and pre-reviews, engaging the right stakeholders across teams, and managing meeting quality and efficiency.
Manage effective communications to leadership and across teams on key decisions, status, and risks to ensure accountability and timeline management.
Understand best practices, drive for process improvements, and find new ways of operating, with a focus on simplification and productivity.
Drive org-wide and company-wide technical initiatives as we evolve our technical stack to scale for the next decade
Provide visibility into key performance indicators so leaders are aware of risks and opportunities.

Experience developing processes where few exist, and demonstrated flexibility to get things done.
Demonstrated ability to work through ambiguity to detailed solutions. You can take a vague problem, crisply frame the challenge, identify a path forward, and drive an initiative over the finish-line.
Good understanding of software engineers principles & proven ability to work in a distributed architecture environment.
Self-motivated, proactive and proven ability to adapt well and work with teams having different operating cadences.
Detail-oriented and able to understand the bigger picture by using your technical expertise and problem solving abilities to prioritize and manage blocking issues.
Experience working in a highly cross-functional environment where communication with multiple groups is imperative.
Ability to ramp up quickly and learn new technologies with minimal lag time.
Excellent written and oral business communication and people skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders.
Exhibit knowledge of Jira or other equivalent task management tooling.
BA/BS degree, 7+ years experience in software development industry

What "Great" Looks Like
A successful candidate in this role demonstrates strong ownership of the AMER learner funnel, proactively driving performance rather than simply executing assigned tasks. Impact – und zwar messbar. Messbar meinen wir wörtlich: Zu jeder Initiative gehören ein KPI und ein Tracking-Konzept, mit dem sich Vorher und Nachher belegen lassen.

Und der ganz normale Rest. Projektpläne, Timings, Budgets und Status-Reports hältst du zuverlässig auf Kurs. Meetings, Workshops, Sprint-Plannings und Retros moderierst du so, dass hinterher alle wissen, was Sache ist. Risiken erkennst du, bevor sie eins werden.
Deine Spezialisierung: PIM oder ERP
Hier liegt der Unterschied zu einer klassischen PM-Stelle. Eins von beidem bringst du mit:

ERP (Odoo) – Bestände, Preise, Aufträge, Rechnungen, Schnittstellen. Du kannst einschätzen, was ins ERP gehört, was in den Shop und was besser in keins von beidem.
Beides mitzubringen wäre Angeberei – wir hätten aber nichts dagegen.
Du kommst aus einer vergleichbaren Welt, nur mit anderen Systemen (Akeneo, Contentserv, SAP, Business Central)? Dann sprich uns trotzdem an. Uns interessiert, ob du die Zusammenhänge verstehst, nicht welches Logo auf dem Login-Screen war.

About Phaidra
Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.
The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.
Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:
We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.
We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.

The Readiness & Response Team keeps Zoox's robotaxi fleet moving. Readiness prepares vehicles for service; Response protects the mission once vehicles are live — recovering vehicles, recovering riders, and coordinating incident response across every market we operate. When a robotaxi needs help on public roads, Response is what gets there, and our dispatchers are the nerve center that makes it happen.

As Program Manager, Response, you own the Response program end to end and lead the centralized dispatch team that runs it. You will not lead crews in the field — market leadership owns field execution.

You own dispatch, the recovery vendor network, the metric set, and the standards that make Response work the same way in Las Vegas as it does in Atlanta.

This is a builder's role in a program scaling toward a national footprint without scaling headcount at the same rate, and you will spend as much time designing how the work should be done as you will running it.

Lead the dispatch team: Manage, coach, and develop a team of Readiness and Response Dispatchers providing 24-hour coverage across all markets — including hiring, shift structure, scheduling, on-call rotation, and performance management.
Own Response program execution: Drive the four pillars of the program — vehicle recovery, rider recovery, incident response, and dispatch and oversight — across San Francisco, Foster City, Las Vegas, Austin, Miami, Los Angeles, and Atlanta, and stand the program up in each new market we launch.
Run the recovery vendor network: Hold third-party tow and rider recovery partners to their service levels through scorecards, escalation, and capacity planning, partnering with Logistics on contracts and Finance on cost per recovery.
Own the metrics: Define, instrument, and report the Response metric set — time to dispatch, dispatch to cleared scene, dispatch cancellation rate, recovery SLA attainment, recovery damage events, and cost per recovery — and use it to drive decisions rather than describe them.
Standardize the work: Support authoring and maintaining the workflows, escalation matrices, and management-of-change process that keep Response consistent across markets — build once, deploy everywhere.
Close the loop on incidents: Run post-incident retrospectives to a real standard — containment, solution, preventive action — and make sure the assigned actions actually land.
Partner across the stack: Work with Mission Control, GSOC, the Fusion Center, Safety, Product, and market leadership to remove the friction that shows up between the dispatch decision and the cleared scene.
Communicate up and out: Deliver the weekly Response update to leadership and represent the program in business reviews — TL;DR first, data-backed, no surprises.
