Since the 2026 season, Audi has been competing in the FIA Formula 1 World Championship.
The new team has three locations. The Motorsport Competence Center of Audi in Neuburg (Germany) is considered one of the most modern of its kind in Europe. The Formula 1 factory of Audi Motorsport AG in Hinwil (Switzerland) is known for its innovative technologies and passion for racing. The Audi Motorsport Technology Center in UK is in its launch phase and growing continuously. Our Power Unit comes from Neuburg, while Hinwil is responsible for the development of the chassis and race operations.
What you need? The mindset of an athlete. If you are someone for whom giving up isn-t an option and limits are just something to be overcome, you can bring Vorsprung durch Technik to Formula 1 with us. Become part of this unique project and make motorsport history.
This position is to be filled at Audi Formula Racing GmbH in Neuburg (Germany).
In program management, we act as the central unit of Audi Formula Racing GmbH. We form the interface between the technical areas, the supply chain and the financial management of the company and are thus responsible for the complex project management for the development and production of the Audi F1 Powertrain.

We operate in a highly exciting, always time-critical and rapidly changing environment. Through intensive cooperation, we ensure transparency for the achievement of project goals and early identification of project risks. In addition to high personal standards, willingness to communicate and team performance, we also focus on enjoying our work!

Due to the dependence of many different topics in our area of responsibility, close cooperation and a high degree of openness are prerequisites for our successful work.

* Project planning and management: Responsibility for the planning, implementation and control of projects within the framework of Audi Formula 1 activities. Creation of transparency about development and supply chain processes for the Audi F1 Power Unit.
* Align and set milestones, goals, and timelines to ensure that all projects are on track to achieve overall goals.
* Cross-departmental coordination: Close cooperation with the project manager, the development teams of the Power Unit and the adjacent departments of logistics, procurement, quality assurance and workshops. Ensure a smooth flow between these teams to optimize the development cycles of the power unit components.
* Risk management: Identification of risks and proactive development of measures and proposed solutions so as not to jeopardize project results.
* Reporting: Regular reports to AFR management on the progress and status of projects.
* Continuous process optimization: Analyze and improve existing operations with a focus on program management and supply chain processes to continuously increase efficiency and performance.
* Progress monitoring and evaluation: Regularly reviewing project progress to ensure that strategic goals are being met and adjustments can be made in a timely manner if necessary.
## Your Profile ##
* Professional experience: Several years of experience in project management, preferably in the motorsport industry or in a comparably demanding environment with high dynamics and technical complexity.
* Technical understanding: A high level of understanding of the technical processes and requirements in the Formula 1 environment in order to be able to coordinate and control projects efficiently.
* Methodological skills: Sound knowledge of project management methods as well as in the areas of time and resource planning, risk management and cost control.
* Experience in project management of interdisciplinary teams and the motivation of employees in a dynamic environment.
* You have business fluency in German or English and are willing to learn basic knowledge of the other language.
* Resilience and flexibility: High resilience and the ability to deliver high-quality results under high pressure in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.
* Problem-solving skills: Strong ability to analyze complex problems and develop creative, pragmatic solutions.
* International experience: Willingness to travel as well as intercultural competence to operate effectively in a global environment.

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

As a Technical Program Manager , you will be a key player in our pre-sales and customer solutioning efforts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Product, and Engineering to scope technical solutions that align with customer needs and drive Spreedly's growth. This is a customer-facing, consultative role focused on understanding prospect pain points and designing solutions that connect Spreedly's platform capabilities to business outcomes.
You will also influence revenue growth, shorten time-to-close, and accelerate value realization for our customers. As Spreedly scales, this role will shape our go-to-market infrastructure through solution templates, demo assets, and mentoring, making it an ideal opportunity for impact and professional growth.
This is a US-based customer-facing role supporting primarily US customers and cross-functional teams operating within US business hours. Success in this role requires regular travel within the United States and the ability to work in alignment with US customer and internal stakeholder schedules.

Lead technical discovery sessions with prospects and customers to identify needs and align use cases to Spreedly's capabilities
Deliver compelling demos, architecture diagrams, and documentation that support sales conversations and technical evaluation
Translate business and technical requirements into actionable solution proposals and implementation plans that support scalability and reuse
Develop and maintain reusable demo environments, solution artifacts, and objection handling templates
Work with Product and Engineering teams to provide prospect feedback and ensure solution feasibility
Partner with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure smooth implementation handoffs
Serve as a technical expert in RFPs, security reviews, and compliance questionnaires
Educate internal teams on platform capabilities, integration patterns, and sales enablement materials

3+ years in a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Account Manager role within a B2B SaaS or fintech environment
Industry experience with eCommerce, PSPs, payment orchestration, or payment platforms
Background in payments, card-not-present commerce, fraud, or gateways preferred
Strong knowledge of APIs, SDKs, and system integration principles (especially REST and webhooks)

Additional Information

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:
Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

s.h: What It's Like to Work Here
s.t:
We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.
--
We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.
--
Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.
Due to the sensitive nature of what Spreedly does - handling payment data - finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.
At this time Spreedly is unable to provide sponsorship for employment, and we are not set up to support remote employees who reside in New York. In order to be considered for employment, applicants must be currently legally authorized to work in the job location country and not require future sponsorship in order to continue working in that country.

The Technical Program Manager plans, executes, and brings projects to closure on behalf of Digital Safety. The Technical Program Manager oversees the entire technical project lifecycle, ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to the specified scope and quality requirements. The Technical Program Manager manages resources, coordinates teams, and mitigates risks to deliver successful project outcomes.

AtUL Research Institutes(ULRI),weexpand the boundaries of safety science tocreate a more secure and sustainable world. Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us.Join us and work with our Fire Safetyteamswho conduct the researchrequiredto produce that knowledgeandput itintopractice.

The Digital Safety Research Institute (DSRI) addresses unresolved safety risks and emerging dangers in the world’s digital ecosystem. We aim to help protect people from unwanted access to personal devices and privacy,algorithms, and disinformation threats by working to create a new digital safety ecosystem.
DSRI is committed to sharing digital safety insights, collaborating with key stakeholders, and offering extensive outreach and education to help support safer digital environments for people everywhere.

Define projectobjectives, scope, deliverables, and success criteria and develop comprehensive project plans, including schedules, budgets, and resource allocation,Identifyingproject dependencies, risks, and mitigation strategies.

Manage changes to project scope, schedule, and resources, followingappropriate changecontrol processes and proactivelyidentifyand resolve project issues and conflicts.
Escalate critical risks and issues toappropriate stakeholdersand senior management.
Ensure compliance with organizational policies, sponsor requirements, research data-handling expectations, andour open-source release processes.
Establishandmaintainstrong relationships with project stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and collaboration. and provide regular project status reports and updates to stakeholders, including progress, milestones, and key decisions.

As an IT Program Manager (Service Designer), GS-2210-15, you will be responsible for: Leading discovery and design efforts rooted in empathy for students, families, and financial aid administrators. Ensuring FSA services are intuitive and accessible to users of all backgrounds, and that every interaction builds trust and confidence in the program.

Looking beyond the screen to understand and improve the end-to-end journey of applying for and receiving aid, mapping processes, policies, and touchpoints across agencies and partners, identifying pain points and opportunities for more seamless, equitable services.

Designing solutions that account for the full ecosystem, not just individual transactions. Leading usability testing with diverse users, incorporating feedback into design iterations. Ensuring that final solutions can scale to millions of FSA users while maintaining clarity, accessibility, and reliability.

Championing design to drive organizational change, challenging outdated processes and building alignment across stakeholders. Proactively pushing through barriers to user-focused innovation and modeling a bias for action to unlock better outcomes for students and families within a complex federal environment.

Working hand-in-hand with product managers, engineers, policy experts, and contractors to ensure design decisions are fully integrated into development.

Mentoring others in human-centered and service design practices, elevating the organization's overall design maturity and building a culture that values design as essential to delivering public services that work for everyone.
Minimum Qualification Requirements You may meet the minimum qualifications for the GS-15, if you possess the specialize experience.

Specialized Experience for the GS-15 One year of experience in either federal or non-federal service that is equivalent to at least a GS-14 performing two (2) out of three (3) of the following duties or work assignments: 1.

Experience leading or serving in a senior role of a multi-disciplinary project involving the design, development, and implementation of a new system or a major enhancement to an existing IT system. 2. Experience serving as a design lead, overseeing adoption of new functionalities and/or technologies for users. 3.

Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences and translating business requirements into technical user stories.

Basic Experience Requirements: Applicants may qualify by meeting or exceeding the minimum proficiency level established for each of the required competencies, in addition to meeting the specialized experience requirement as demonstrated through the assessment of skills.

You must possess IT-related experience (paid or unpaid experience and/or completion of specific, intensive training (e.g., IT certification), as appropriate) demonstrating each of the nine competencies listed below. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (i.e., any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Decision Making - Makes sound, well-informed, and objective decisions; perceives the impact and implications of decisions; commits to action, even in uncertain situations, to accomplish organizational goals; causes change.

Information Management - Identifies a need for and knows where or how to gather information; organizes and maintains information or information management systems.

Interpersonal Skills- Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations.

Oral Communication- Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

Problem Solving- Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Teamwork- Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.

Technical Competence- Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs) The quality of your experience will be measured by the extent to which you possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities (KSAs).

You do not need to provide separate narrative responses to these KSAs, as they will be measured by your responses to the occupational questionnaire (you may preview the occupational questionnaire by clicking the link at the end of the Evaluations section of this vacancy announcement). Skill human-centered design and user experience methods.

Skill in service design and systems thinking. Skill in prototyping, testing, and iterating solutions at scale. Skill in navigating bureaucracy and driving design-led change. Ability to collaborate across disciplines and build a culture of design.

A Careers - Psychologist: https://youtube.com/embed/77qHlLw9Xck Total Rewards of a Allied Health Professional The Workplace Violence Prevention Program (WVPP) is accountable for clinical and administrative operations for Tuscaloosa VA Medical Center and is expected to adhere to service standards regarding matters of timeliness, accuracy and compliance with procedures and quality of work produced.

The purpose of this hybrid position, with 80% administrative and 20% clinical time allotted is to direct the administrative and clinical aspects of the WVPP program.

Major duties include but not limited to: Forming and maintaining a cohesive team of staff from a variety of disciplines and supervisory chains of authority to ensure targeted and evidence-based efforts to ensure the safety of TVAMC stakeholders.

The WVPP has oversight and administrative authority over all programming and participates in program development, implementation, and evaluation. The WVPP Program Manager works with the service and hospital Accreditation Committees to ensure all programming, documentation and physical environment meets or exceeds current standards.

The essential program management responsibilities of the WVPP Program Manager include coordination of all aspects of the Workplace Violence Prevention Program for TVAMC .

Interpreting and writing policies, procedures, and program guidelines in the development, planning, operations, and continuous performance improvement of all components of the WVPP. Being responsible for responding to FOIA and Congressional requests and inquiries directed to the DBC and/or the WVPP.

Ensuring all workplace violence prevention activities within the facility take a trauma-informed approach, while also ensuring the safety of Veterans, visitors, volunteers, contractors, trainees and staff as the primary goal.

Collaborating effectively with the Mental Health Service Line leadership, Executive Leadership Team, legal representatives, the Office of Inspector General, court officials including the Assistant U.S. Attorney, police (VA and community), and other consumers and/or community providers when necessary.

Obtaining and maintaining PMDB Certified Trainer status, and obtaining and maintaining Master Trainer Status, which will require travel to other VHA and DoD facilities nationwide, to teach PMDB Train-the-Trainer courses.

Leading the Behavioral Rapid Response Team (BRRT) of administrative and clinical executives such as the Chief of Staff (COS), Chief of Police, Regional Counsel, Patient Safety, Mental Health, to assess, triage and manage patient-generative disruptive behavior immediately.

Maintaining knowledge and use of latest evidence-based risk assessment and management literature and tools, conducting clinical threat/risk assessments of Veterans and Veteran-generative disruptive behavior to determine recommendations for risk mitigation to be used in consultation with providers, clinical staff and DBC members.

Leading a team of Administrative and Clinical Executives including Human Resource Employee Relations/Labor Relations representatives, Executive Office representative, Chief of Police or other senior-level representatives, Registered Nurse, and representative from local union and labor bargaining unit to assess, triage and manage employee-generated disruptive behavior immediately.

Responsible for financial management of the WVPP section, including budget oversight, planning and management. Developing annual strategic and budget plans for the WVPP section consistent with guidance and goals from the Mental Health Service Line, Director's Office and/or Fiscal Service and oversees its execution and monitoring for complications.

The WVPP Program Manager will dedicate up to 10% of their time to direct clinical care based on facility clinical needs and consistent with their professional discipline and credentialing/privileging. The Advanced Practice Nurse (Nurse Practitioner)-Behavioral Health Interdisciplinary Program (BHIP) Manager provides care and counseling of persons to promote and maintain health and the prevention of illness and injury based upon the nursing process, which includes systematic data gathering, assessment, appropriate nursing judgment, and evaluation of human responses to actual or potential health problems through such services as case finding, health teaching, health counseling, provision of care supportive to or restorative of life and well-being, and executing medical regimens, including administering medications and treatments prescribed by a licensed or otherwise legally authorized provider.

The APN's primary commitment is to the patient, whether an individual, family, group, or community.

The APN interprets the philosophy and goals of the Nursing Service to others in the work setting; functions within established guidelines and demonstrates the ability to work effectively and develop therapeutic relationships with patients, their families and other professional and supportive personnel who provide patient care.

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Leading and organizing delivery of care to assure continuity of care and peer accountability for practice, including access to care and discharge planning. Using advanced clinical knowledge/judgment to promote staff involvement in planning, decision-making, and evaluating outcomes.

Functioning as an expert in clinical practice and/or areas related to the assigned roles and responsibilities. Systematically evaluating current practice and formulating outcomes for groups of patients and/or organizational processes within an area of expertise. Guiding, developing, and supporting staff from a leadership perspective.

Using professional standards of care, scientific evidence, and practice to evaluate programs and/or service activities.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Claude is used across government, from US federal civilian agencies to national security, state and local, and allied international governments, and nearly every model and product Anthropic ships has public sector work on the end of it.

Each of those segments runs under its own regulatory and deployment constraints, so delivering Claude to them means standing up compliant infrastructure with cloud partners, landing new models in restricted environments, bringing our application suite to parity with commercial, and clearing frameworks like FedRAMP, repeated for every segment.

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to own that program.
Today that coordination is spread across the public sector product and engineering leads and the many teams they pull in: research, infrastructure, security, compliance, and product engineering. You'll become the single owner of that program, the person who knows where every workstream stands, what it is waiting on, and who needs to decide.

Over time, government customers get new models and products on a predictable cadence, authorizations like FedRAMP run as a steady program rather than a one-off push, and each new segment takes less bespoke effort than the last.

Own the program for delivering new Claude models into public sector environments: sequencing, dependencies, and tradeoffs across research, inference and capacity, cloud partners, safeguards, and compliance teams
Drive FedRAMP and similar authorization programs for Anthropic's public sector offerings, working with privacy, security, compliance, and platform engineering
Plan and sequence work across public sector segments, from model and API availability to application parity and segment-specific product work
Represent public sector requirements in model launch planning alongside the launch TPMs
Establish the operating rhythm: a single view of workstreams, owners, dependencies, risks, and status, with planning, escalation paths, and launch coordination across orgs
Convert recurring efforts into documented, repeatable processes so that each new segment or model requires less bespoke coordination
You may be a good fit if you
Have several years of experience in technical program management, with a track record of successfully delivering complex, cross-functional programs
Have shipped software or infrastructure into regulated or restricted environments (government clouds, air-gapped deployments, FedRAMP or similar authorization frameworks) and can engage meaningfully with the infrastructure, ML, and security engineers doing the work
Have experience coordinating across multiple engineering teams and organizations simultaneously, including research, security, and compliance partners
Are highly organized and can manage multiple parallel workstreams effectively across distributed teams
Thrive in unstructured environments with a knack for bringing order to chaos and creating clarity in ambiguous situations
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority
Have worked on public sector, defense, or government cloud programs, or hold or are eligible for a US security clearance (preferred but not required)
Are passionate about Anthropic's mission and interested in the challenges of bringing AI capabilities to public institutions safely and reliably
Are a US person. We have agreements with the US Government that mandate this for these roles.

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale SMB initiatives — from scoping and governance through to sign-off, communications and reporting — so senior teams can track commercial impact.
Apply a consistent, recognised methodology (PRINCE2 or Six Sigma) to give initiatives clear milestones, risk management and quality control.
Design and embed a structured engagement framework for the Hub, defining how initiatives are prioritised, resourced and measured.
Strategic Planning

Collaborate with senior leadership across Sales, NMX and Account Management to align delivery capacity with Hub priorities.

Own the SMB communications strategy — channel ownership, sequencing and accountability — to improve clarity and consistency of key messages.
Produce clear, structured reporting that translates operational detail into decisions for senior stakeholders.
Act as the conduit between Sales, NPX, Account Management, Partner Support and Ops, keeping a wide stakeholder group aligned and informed.

Leading delivery of the Hub's structured engagement framework, defining how initiatives are prioritised and measured.

Partnering with the commercial excellence and central teams to build robust plans that drive change through better engagement, improved efficiency or increased capability.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
Creators are people who build audiences across the internet: influential voices whose communities listen to them and want to spend time together. Many of those communities already live on Discord, but our relationship with creators has grown organically. We have an opportunity to listen more closely, serve them more intentionally, and build a relationship that reflects the role they play on our platform.
We’re hiring a Senior Staff Program Manager to build Discord’s approach to creators from the ground up. You’ll begin with a selected group of creators already using Discord, build the fundamentals that serve them well, and develop programs that make their experience on Discord better.

Over time, you’ll turn what works into programs that can serve creators at scale and, eventually, give new creators more reasons to choose Discord. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can lead through judgment, relationships, and execution.

You’ll report to the Director of Marketing, Player Communications and partner closely with Support, Product, Marketing, Communications, Partnerships, Policy, and more.
What You'll Be Doing
Build Discord’s creator strategy from the bottom up, starting with direct conversations and a clear understanding of what creators already on Discord need from us.
Bring together the creator work that exists across Discord today, establish clear ownership, and turn a collection of early efforts into a coherent program.
Define who we mean by creators and develop an initial approach for selecting and serving a trusted group across games, platforms, formats, and communities.
Create more than one program for creators, beginning with the fundamentals: accelerated support, clear paths for escalation, and reliable channels for two-way communication.
Manage relationships with important creators directly. Understand how they use Discord, help them solve meaningful problems, and build trust by following through.
Build a creator council or network that gives us a consistent view of what creators are seeing, where Discord is falling short, and what would make the platform more useful to them and their communities.
Build systems and playbooks that let a selected program grow over time without losing the relationships and responsiveness that made it valuable.
What you should have
A strong passion for Discord and/or gaming, and an appreciation for the creators and communities we serve.
7+ years in creator partnerships, community, platform programs, marketing, product partnerships, or a related field.
Deeply familiar with how creators build audiences, operate their businesses, and manage communities across platforms like YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, Patreon, Reddit, and Discord.
You have built and operated creator or partner programs at scale, and you understand how to begin with a selected group without designing something that can never grow beyond it.
Biased to ship and iterate. You can launch a useful first version, learn from it, and raise the ambition over time.
Comfortable leading as an individual contributor. You create alignment and momentum across teams without relying on headcount or reporting lines.
An excellent cross-functional partner across Support, Product, Marketing, Comms, Partnerships, Policy, and more.

You have built a creator, partner, ambassador, advisory, or VIP program for a consumer platform.
You have designed accelerated support or escalation programs for influential users.
You have worked directly with gaming creators and understand the relationship between creators, games, and communities.
You have built programs involving product access, creator events, recognition, or discovery.
You have helped turn creator feedback into product changes, policies, or platform strategy.
You have built a program that began with a small trusted group and expanded without losing what made it valuable.

Job Title
Procurement Project Manager
Job Description
The Procurement Project Manager - Mother&Child Care is responsible for handling small-scale procurement projects or subprojects, ensuring alignment with project objectives, specifications, timelines, and resource requirements, working under general supervision.

The role takes care of the savings funnel by tracking cost-saving initiatives and identifying opportunities for cost reduction and process optimization. The role participates in phase-in and phase-out planning for new product introductions and lifecycle management activities.

The role executes comprehensive project management plans, resolves issues, and ensures adherence to procurement standards.

· Initiates and plans small-scale projects or subprojects within the procurement domain, ensuring alignment with project objectives, specifications, timelines, and resource requirements and applies awareness of entrepreneurial skills in daily work.

· Handles the savings funnel, tracking cost-saving initiatives, monitoring progress against targets, and identifying opportunities for cost reduction and process optimization, working under general supervision.

· Participates in phase-in and phase-out (PIPO) planning related to new product introduction and lifecycle management (LCM) activities, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless transitions and alignment with procurement goals.

· Executes comprehensive project management plans, outlining project scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, and resource allocations to guide project execution and control.

· Implements project activities, overseeing project progress, resolving issues, and ensuring adherence to project plans and procurement standards.

· Identifies and resolves project issues and risks, escalating critical issues to project stakeholders and management as necessary to minimize disruptions and mitigate project impacts.

· Provides regular project updates and reports to project stakeholders, communicating project status, milestones, risks, and issues to ensure transparency and alignment with project objectives.

· Drafts project documentation and records, including project plans, meeting minutes, and status reports, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and accessibility for project team members and stakeholders.

· Ensures compliance with procurement policies, procedures, and regulations, adhering to ethical standards and promoting a culture of integrity and transparency within the procurement function.

· Understands and applies best practices in project management and procurement, continuously learning and adapting to evolving industry trends, technologies, and methodologies to drive procurement excellence.
Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management OR Vocational Education in Project Management or equivalent.

No prior experience required with Bachelor's Degree OR minimum 4 years of experience with Vocational Education in areas such as Project Management, Program Management, Portfolio Management, Agile Methodology or equivalent.

## Rejoins notre équipe tipee ! ##
Situés au cœur de Lausanne, nous sommes une PME d'une cinquantaine de collaboratrices et collaborateurs passionné-e-s. Nous développons tipee, une application de gestion du temps et portail RH qui simplifie la vie de nos clients depuis plus de 10 ans.
Fonctionnant en mode participatif et agile, notre société est organisée en cercles où chacun-e est autonome, avec son mot à dire et des possibilités d'évolution au sein de la boîte. Et cela, avec un impact positif pour nos clients, nos collègues, la communauté et l'environnement.
Pour renforcer notre organisation, nous cherchons un-e **People & Culture Manager**. Ce poste de cadre te place au cœur de l'humain chez tipee : tu veilles à ce que chacun-e soit soutenu-e et accompagné-e au quotidien, tu fais vivre l'équité et la cohérence de nos pratiques RH, et tu contribues activement à notre culture d'entreprise et à notre marque employeur.
Ce poste combine deux rôles : à titre principal, celui de **People & Culture Manager**, et à titre secondaire, celui de **facilitateur-trice** au sein de nos cercles.
## Ton rôle au quotidien ##
Tu fais partie de la direction et tu travailles en lien étroit avec l'ensemble des cercles et des coordinateurs-trices.
* Tu es **à l'écoute des besoins** des collègues et des coordinateurs-trices, et tu es la personne de référence pour tout sujet touchant à l'humain au sein de tipee.
* Tu accompagnes les cercles dans leurs **recrutements** : tu ne recrutes pas à leur place, tu les outilles pour qu'ils sachent le faire eux-mêmes, et tu les appuies pour optimiser chaque processus.
* Tu conçois et fais vivre un **onboarding et un offboarding formalisés**, pour que chaque nouvel-le arrivant-e soit bien accueilli-e et chaque départ bien accompagné, quel que soit le cercle.
* Tu accompagnes l'évolution professionnelle des collaborateurs-trices : entretiens annuels en duo lorsque nécessaire, discussions avec les personnes concernées, et une réflexion continue sur les **parcours et la mobilité interne**.
* En collaboration avec les cadres, tu gères les **situations difficiles** (résolution de tensions, recadrage, conflit, etc.), avec la discrétion et l'écoute que ces moments demandent.
* Tu participes à la **diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion (DEIB)** au sein de tipee, et tu veilles à ce que nos pratiques soient inclusives à chaque étape du parcours collaborateur-trice.
* Tu clarifies et fais vivre **nos bonnes pratiques** : rédaction de guides, conventions et chartes en duo avec la direction, et contribution aux réflexions sur notre culture d'entreprise lors des séances cadres.
* Tu portes le rôle de **facilitateur-trice** : animation de rituels et stimulation de l'intelligence collective au sein de nos cercles.
* Tu participes à l'**organisation et à l'animation** de nos journées annuelles au vert.
* Tu t'assures que nos **cercles et rôles** suivent l'évolution de nos équipes.
* Tu **représentes tipee** à l'externe, lors de conférences ou salons RH, et tu partages ainsi notre vision de l'humain au travail.
* Tu favorises le **partage de connaissances** en interne et l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques, notamment via le suivi de notre questionnaire eNPS.
## Ce qu'on recherche ##
* Une expérience confirmée dans un rôle très orienté vers l'humain "- People & Culture, coaching, facilitation, Scrum Master, ou fonction similaire.
* Une posture de coach : tu préfères outiller et responsabiliser les équipes plutôt que de faire à leur place.
* Une réelle capacité d'écoute, d'empathie et de discrétion, notamment dans les situations sensibles.
* Un esprit d'initiative et l'envie de faire évoluer nos pratiques.
* Une aisance avec la culture produit, l'agilité et la facilitation (animation de rituels, intelligence collective, gestion des tensions).
* Le goût de représenter une entreprise à l'externe et de créer des partenariats.
* Une bonne compréhension du fonctionnement en cercles et en rôles, ou l'envie de t'y investir pleinement.
* De bonnes connaissances RH sont un plus, mais ne sont pas une condition.
Tu n'as pas besoin d'avoir un parcours RH classique pour réussir dans ce rôle : ce n'est pas un poste d'administration du personnel. Ce qui compte avant tout, c'est ta capacité à accompagner les gens, à faciliter, à créer de la confiance et être un soutien.
## Travailler chez tipee ##
* **Flexibilité** : horaires modulables, travail hybride (jusqu'à 50% à distance), taux d'activité adaptable à l'évolution de ta vie personnelle.
* **Locaux à Lausanne** : à 15 minutes à pied de la gare, ou 7 en vélo ou trottinette.
* **Formation** : un budget individuel pour des conférences ou formations sur les sujets qui t'intéressent.
* **Culture participative** : entraide, dialogue, confiance, prise de responsabilités.
* **Engagements** : certifiée B Corp et STI, engagée sur les aspects sociétaux et environnementaux.
* **Mobilité** : jusqu'à CHF 300.- par année pour tes frais de transport durable (abonnement CFF).
* **Conditions** : des prestations LPP attractives auprès d'une caisse durable, des avantages autour du congé parental, au moins 5 semaines de vacances, et plus.
* **Vie d'entreprise** : événements réguliers et moments conviviaux qui rythment l'année.

Bau\-/ Projektleiter
====================
Die IMAG Gruppe ist eine inhabergeführte Unternehmensgruppe, die alle Management\-Dienstleistungen für Immobilienprojekte in der Region Zürich und Zug erbringt. Dabei bietet die IMAG Gruppe massgeschneiderte Lösungen, die flexibel und verlässlich umgesetzt werden.

Unser Fokus liegt auf qualitativen Bauten für unsere Kunden, der Förderung und Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden sowie einem nachhaltigen Umgang mit unserer Umwelt. Dabei setzen wir auf flache Hierarchien, direkte Kommunikation und ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld.
**Bau\-/ Projektleiter**
------------------------
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine verantwortungsvolle, selbständig arbeitende Persönlichkeit mit fundierter Praxiserfahrung im Bau\- oder Projektmanagement. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Leitung anspruchsvoller Bauprojekte von der Planung bis zur Übergabe. Sie koordinieren interne und externe Projektbeteiligte, stellen Qualität, Termine und Kosten sicher und sind zentrale Ansprechperson für Bauherren, Fachplaner und Unternehmer.
**Ihr Verantwortungsbereich:**
* Bau\-/ Projektleitung für die zugeteilten Bauprojekte
* Koordination der Architekten, Fachplanenden, Behörden, Unternehmen und Dritten
* Einhaltung von Qualität, Terminen und Kosten
* Zuverlässiges und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
* Lösungsfindung für eventuelle Bauproblematiken
* Verantwortung für die Realisierung der Bauprojekte zur vollsten Zufriedenheit der Kunden
* Beraten und Begleiten der Bauherrschaften
* Rapport an den Gesamtprojektleiter
**Ihr Profil:**
* Sie verfügen über ein stilsicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
* Sie sind idealerweise eidg. dipl. Bauleiter, Bautechniker (Hochbau) oder Architekt oder haben die Funktion als Bauleiter schon mehrere Jahre ausgeübt
* Sie sind zielorientiert, können neue Gegebenheiten adaptieren und behalten auch in stressigen Situationen den Überblick
* Sie besitzen unternehmerisches Denken, Verhandlungsgeschick, sind leistungswillig und innovativ
* Sie überzeugen durch Ihre hohe Sozial\- und Fachkompetenz, Ihre kommunikativen Fähigkeiten sowie durch Ihr Organisationstalent
**Das bieten wir Ihnen:**
* Positives Betriebsklima mit wirkungsvoller Feedbackkultur
* Angemessene Entlohnung mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
* Intensive individuelle Weiterentwicklung (Schulungen, Workshops, Praxistage, Coachings) in Führung und Kommunikation am eigenen IMAG Campus mit persönlichem Trainer
* Hochwertiges Equipment
* Digitales arbeiten, weitgehend papierlos
* Modernes und klimatisiertes Büro inmitten des pulsierenden Glattzentrums
* zahlreiche Verpflegungsangebote und attraktive Einkaufsvorteile im Glattzentrum

### Aufgaben ###
*Welche Aufgaben erwarten dich als Projektleiter Bauphysik & Nachhaltigkeit (m/w/d)?*
* Du leitest Projekte im nachhaltigen Bauen und in der Bauphysik eigenständig und setzt sie erfolgreich um.
* Du erstellst Berechnungen und Nachweise, von Energienachweisen und Wärmebrückenberechnungen bis zu Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) und der zugehörigen Dokumentation.
* Du führst Messungen, beispielsweise zur Innenraumluftqualität, durch und erstellst Simulationen.
* Auf Baustellen übernimmst du Kontrollgänge und führst Qualitätsprüfungen durch.
* Du berätst und begleitest Planerinnen, Planer sowie weitere Projektbeteiligte bei bauphysikalischen und nachhaltigkeitsbezogenen Anforderungen.
* Bei Neu- und Bestandsbauprojekten verantwortest du Themen wie thermische Behaglichkeit, Feuchteschutz, Luftdichtigkeit, Tageslicht und optional Bauakustik.
* Du führst Nachhaltigkeitszertifizierungen wie SNBS, Minergie, Minergie-ECO, DGNB, LEED, WELL oder BREEAM durch und begleitest den gesamten Prozess.
* Dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung teilst du gerne mit weniger erfahrenen Teammitgliedern.
* In der Zusammenarbeit mit hochqualifizierten Fachpersonen entwickelst du deine eigenen Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiter.
